messages:
Maya (CS): Kickoff note for Heliotrope private/VPC onboard. Week0 done, week1 networking + security items. Customer requires 365d audit retention, quarterly KMS rotation evidence, and signed audit export for compliance. Any immediate gaps?
Evan (CSE): Preflight: CIDR 10.100.0.0/20 assigned. They also asked for a small /28 for bastion mgmt. Need confirmation on NAT egress and where Splunk collector sits.
Nora (SRE): Peering plan OK from our side; we have peering-heap active but missing their reciprocal route. Asked them to add route for 10.100.0.0/20 -> pcx-0a1b2c. Also requested their route table ID.
Diego (Security): KMS: customer prefers CMK in their account with cross-account grants. I'll provide a minimal key policy and grant sequence, plus instructions for rotation logging to CloudTrail -> S3 with lifecycle 365d. Will include sample CLI to extract rotation events.
Maya (CS): @Diego paste the key policy snippet please so I can share with Heliotrope SecOps.
Diego (Security): Snippet (replace ARNs): `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::HELIOTROPE:role/RedwoodKMSUser"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey","kms:CreateGrant","kms:ListGrants"],"Resource":"*"}]}`. Also enable rotation and add cloudtrail:LookupEvents permissions for the audit role.
InfraBot: Route applied RTB-az2 -> subnet-app-02, NAT ngw-11 created (us-east-2) :white_check_mark:
Evan (CSE): IAM note: create cross-account role RedwoodDeployRole with assume role policy pointing to arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD:role/infra-deploy. Restrict S3 put to `s3://heliotrope-logs/redwood/` prefix. I'll validate once they share role ARN.
Priya (Account Exec): Renewal calendar flagged 75 days. Heliotrope is evaluating expanded commit. If we can provide audit PDFs + signed rotation proof within 7 days, good chance to accelerate renewal. Main risk: peering not confirmed and evidence delays.
Nora (SRE): Confirmed peering on our side and NAT health. Peering-status: pending on Heliotrope. Sent CLI for route add and asked for peering acceptance ID.
Heliotrope (Customer): Thanks. We'll push the route today and share role ARN. Is the rotation report a one-off PDF we can attach to our audit portal?
Diego (Security): Yes. We'll run a CloudTrail query, export CSV, wrap with brief signed statement and render to PDF. We'll drop it in S3 and provide a presigned URL (30d).
Maya (CS): Actions: 1) @Nora follow peering ack 2) @Diego finalize key policy + rotation export template 3) @Evan validate assume-role & test S3 put 4) @Priya track renewal playbook with legal. I'll send consolidated next steps to Heliotrope and schedule check-in Fri 10am PT. Thread closed once route + ARN + proof link received. :white_check_mark:
